subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers ask for a rebased SDK-owner update on this PR, adopt the fix into a replacement branch, or let the stale conflicting PR close later?
rationale: The underlying bug is valid and still present, but this external PR is conflicting, targets stale helper ownership, and lacks real behavior proof, so automation should not merge it as-is.

options.title: Request rebased SDK-owner update
options.body: Ask the contributor to port the cache ownership check and tests to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, then add redacted real behavior proof for two Copilot profiles.

options.title: Maintainer-adopt replacement fix
options.body: A maintainer can sponsor a narrow replacement PR if the bug needs faster handling than the stale branch can provide.

options.title: Pause or close later
options.body: If no one refreshes the branch after the proof window and inactivity gates are met, close it while keeping the canonical issue open or replaced.

recommendation.title: Request rebased SDK-owner update
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to port the cache ownership check and tests to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, then add redacted real behavior proof for two Copilot profiles.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blocker is the plugin/SDK owner boundary introduced by the plugin auth cleanup path.
